claims: Tyson Fury is returning from retirement to fight Arslanbek Makhmudov on Saturday, April 11, 2026, at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London.
Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov is a heavyweight bout.
Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov marks Tyson Fury's comeback after a 15-month absence.
The fight card for Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov features Conor Benn vs. Regis Prograis.
The fight card for Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov is available to watch on Netflix.
Tyson Fury has expressed desire to fight Anthony Joshua next
